name: Ad Placements End-to-End (banner, purchase)
greenMarker: Ad placements verified by clicking them

mutations.name: the ad slot silently stops rendering
mutations.why: This gate clicks the placements instead of reading the source, because a placement can be present in the code and unreachable on screen. Renaming the export was too blunt a mutation — it broke the build, so the gate died before it ever looked for the slot.
